articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain tools.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which sets new records on agentic task completion benchmarks including SWE-Bench and WebArena. The model introduces improved tool-use chaining and self-verification loops, allowing it to autonomously complete multi-step software engineering workflows with significantly reduced error rates.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the first scaled commercial deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid robots at BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina. The robots handle parts inspection, bin picking, and intra-facility logistics, operating alongside human workers with a reported 97% uptime over the initial pilot phase.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot performing unscripted household tasks including laundry folding, dish loading, and object retrieval using end-to-end vision-language-action models. The demonstration highlighted substantial improvements in fine motor dexterity and real-time obstacle avoidance compared to previous generations.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Enterprise AI Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic released a production-ready framework called Constitutional Classifiers that allows enterprises to define domain-specific safety policies in natural language and enforce them at inference time with minimal latency overhead. The system reduces policy-violating outputs by over 95% while preserving helpfulness scores, addressing a key barrier to enterprise AI adoption.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthrough in High-NA EUV Yield, Accelerating Sub-2nm Chip Production
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-NA EUV lithography systems have achieved production-viable yields at partner fabs, clearing a major hurdle for sub-2nm semiconductor manufacturing. The advancement is expected to accelerate the timeline for next-generation AI accelerator chips from Intel, TSMC, and Samsung by roughly six months.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced sustained fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits with error rates below the critical threshold needed for practical quantum error correction. The result, achieved on Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system using Microsoft's qubit virtualization layer, represents a significant milestone toward scalable quantum computing.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2T Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth under a permissive open license, featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with 1.2 trillion total parameters but only 200 billion active per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on reasoning and coding benchmarks, significantly shifting the open-source vs. closed-source competitive landscape.
